name: How much does sliding door latch repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does sliding door latch repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of sliding door latch repair in the Bay Area can vary widely depending on the type of latch, the extent of the damage, and whether parts need to be replaced. Basic repairs might range from $100 to $250 for labor and minor adjustments. If the entire latch mechanism needs replacement, including specialty hardware, costs could be higher, potentially ranging from $250 to $500 or more, not including the cost of the new latch itself. It's best to get a detailed quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for sliding door latch repair in the Bay Area vary, typically ranging from $100 for minor repairs to $500+ for complex replacements, not including parts.
